summary: Stage 2 Argue the edge for DirectSun. One ask sent, a_shade_takes: what a cast shadow takes from the ground it falls on, (a) only the warmth that pawns feel or (b) also the light that crops and solar panels use, in every lee and under every crown by the one geometry. As built, no shade touches crops or panels, so under (a) the root's 'field' is false and unwanted shade costs mostly a colder outdoor workplace. A fresh Opus reviewer struck the first draft (it said shade touches only pawn heat, but shade also dims sun-powered work tables) and passed it after four fixes.
